description: Land Acquission - Ipalawa, Wariyapola D/S/D, Kurunegala District
categorisation: The gazette content is a formal declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific plots of land for a public purpose. It provides detailed descriptions of the land parcels, including their location, boundaries, and extent. While it is issued by a named Minister, the core subject matter is exclusively land acquisition, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification for land and property-related matters. The mention of the minister is incidental to the authorization of the notice, not the primary focus of the content.
